preconditions.description: The input string S has length N between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: Every character in the input string is a digit from 0 to 9.

postconditions.description: The output is a single non-negative integer.

The output integer equals the minimal number of jumps required to reach the last index from the first index, where a jump from index i allows moving to i-1, i+1 (if within bounds), or any index j where S[j] == S[i].
